name: Miracle
long_description:
Miracle is building the control room for clinical trials. Today, biotech companies rely on fragmented software systems, spreadsheet trackers, and manual processes to manage complex clinical trials. Miracle integrates and consolidates data from disparate sources into a single platform, giving teams real-time visibility, helping them identify risks early, and streamlining workflows to make faster, better decisions.

By unifying clinical trial data, we're also laying the foundation for AI-powered analytics and automation.

Our mission is to modernize how clinical trials are run so new treatments can reach patients faster.
one_liner: Accelerate clinical trials with real-time, actionable insights
